'''Doc''' was an announcer at [[Corpo (Hutt)|Corpo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] extravagant culinary contests who worked alongside his partner [[Fookooey]].

==Behind the scenes==
"Doc" is based on [[Wikipedia:Iron Chef|''Iron Chef'']] announcer [[Wikipedia:Yukio Hattori|Yukio Hattori]], whose nickname, given to him by fellow announcer [[Wikipedia:Kenji Fukui|Kenji Fukui]], is "Doc."
